verdict.rationale: Devin's docs say it can take on tickets and 'repro and fix bugs'. Sessions can start from Slack/Teams threads about a bug, and Auto-Fix fixes flagged bugs and iterates on CI failures. Community reports of a 13.8% issue-resolution rate and a shallow try-catch fix suggest limited reliability, but they do not show the capability is absent, so they lower confidence rather than create a dispute. missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of reliable end-to-end bug diagnosis and fixes, detailed docs on the diagnosis workflow (e.g. reproducing from Sentry/Datadog reports).

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent autonomously diagnose and fix a reported bug

citations.quote: Start sessions directly from conversations about bugs, feature requests, or questions.
Devin automatically responds to code review comments, fixes flagged bugs, and iterates on CI failures
